writeup:
### The arc
The most one-sided matchup of the week. Scarlet Knights never got above ~14% (opening night) and were effectively done by June 3. Not a single tick swung 7pp — there was no drama to swing.

### Final categories
- **Seattle Norsemen (9):** R, HR, H, SB, OPS, K, QS — plus ERA 3.11–7.20 and WHIP 1.06–1.68, a pitching mismatch in every direction.
- **Scarlet Knights (1):** SVHD 2–1.

### What swung it
- Nothing — Scarlet's staff (7.20 ERA / 1.68 WHIP) gave the Norsemen every pitching category and the offense followed.

**Turning point:** There wasn't one; this was a mismatch from first pitch.
